title: AlloyDB Enhances IAM Group User Types
summary: AlloyDB now supports new user types for IAM group-based authentication. This allows for more granular and centralized access management for your database users.
details: The `schemas.User.properties.userType` enum has been extended with three new values: `ALLOYDB_IAM_GROUP`, `ALLOYDB_IAM_GROUP_USER`, and `ALLOYDB_IAM_GROUP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT`. These additions enable more flexible and robust IAM-driven user management within AlloyDB, allowing you to define database users that represent entire IAM groups, individual users within those groups, and service accounts within those groups.
